call_guidance.calendar_input: Date labels use the explicit question_calendar/candidate_calendar, default proleptic Gregorian. Read calendar_conversion and analysis_context.input_calendar/input_date before explaining normalized datetimes. Julian dates use CE Jan1 years; do not infer regional reforms, March25 years or historical LMT/LAT. With explicit noon hour origin, retain raw calendar labels and read clock_conversion.hour_origin_conversion for the final canonical wall date; validate range after nominal day carry.
call_guidance.candidate_inputs: Use the recorded candidate instant, timezone and coordinates; this is not an interval-wide optimum search.
call_guidance.clock_input: Use explicit candidate_clock_basis only from confirmed clock evidence: civil / local_mean_solar / local_apparent_solar. Solar bases must omit/null timezone_name; civil omission preserves the legacy +08:00 default, not evidence of a known zone. Read clock_conversion with calendar_conversion: first normalize date labels, then resolve the declared clock to TT/UT1. Geocentric LAT is not a topocentric sundial reconstruction. Before1960 UTC-named carriers denote UT1 model labels. Never infer an original clock from ASC fit or outcome; numerical residual is not record accuracy.
call_guidance.evidence_boundary: Read calculation_conditions together: native lunar events, physical axes, solar policy, factors, nullable score and unresolved contributions.
call_guidance.hour_origin: Use candidate_hour_origin=noon only for confirmed noon-based clock-hour labels such as Lilly1647 pp30-31 ephemeris tables. Default midnight preserves modern labels. Noon0=same-date12:00; noon12..23=next-date00:00..11:00. Read clock_conversion.hour_origin_conversion, raw calendar date/clock, and canonical candidate_datetime together. Calendar-normalized_local_datetime is a raw hour label and can be null for an unrepresentable intermediate date rescued by the carry; final wall time is separate. This is not physical elapsed duration, a timezone/EOT/JD offset, a house-table coordinate, a regional reform or proof of LMT/LAT. Do not infer the author's convention from a fitted chart. Apply declared hour origin before civil zone/DST validation or solar-clock inversion.
call_guidance.incomplete_score: A null score is incomplete, not zero; score_bounds cover only declared unknown weights, not confidence or outcome probability.
call_guidance.interpretation_boundary: All numeric weights/bands remain uncalibrated product policy; solar definitions and before-ingress event scope do not certify a full original-text election method.
call_guidance.physical_epoch: 太阳时反解的有效时刻可能落在UTC闰秒。converted_utc可含23:59:60；按clock_conversion.utc_representation区分标签与datetime可表示性，计算使用原生TT/UT1。不能把不能解析datetime说成计算失败，也不能将秒60截断、平滑或移到次日；数值标签精度不代表实测钟时精度。
call_guidance.ut1_source: ut1_source默认swiss_delta_t；显式iers_c04使用固定IERS20 C04每日实测合成UT1，仅覆盖1962-01-01 00:00至2026-09-19 00:00 UTC，需要UT1的时刻超范围拒绝；地心TT黄经事件搜索不需要在试算时刻取得UT1，不因C04边界自动变成未知。读取clock_conversion.ut1_reference与calculation_basis.earth_rotation，区分已发布日值和TT上连续UT1-TAI线性插值。只应用UT1，未应用极移、CIP偏移或日内潮汐，形式标准差不是瞬时物理误差界；不得声称完整EOP、史料钟时精度或预测效力。

calculation_conditions.purpose: Native TT lunar events and named physical axes, not house-cusp substitutes. Keep nullable score/hard status and fixed-policy bounds with unknown factor reasons. Solar states use selected Lilly1647 p113 definitions; old score weights/bands remain uncalibrated product policy, not full source judgement or outcome probability.
calculation_conditions.when: 按明确候选时刻核对择日的原生月亮事件、太阳状态、物理ASC/MC、已知因子与未核算项；完整分数缺失时先读范围及原因。

calendar_input.purpose: 核对显式儒略历／延伸格里历日期、转换后的本地钟时与实际TT/UT1；不推断地区改历、旧式年份或历史钟时，不把日期换算当原图复现。

clock_input.purpose: 核对已确认的民用／地方平太阳／地心视太阳钟时、历法转换次序及同一物理TT/UT1；未知原书钟时不拟合，数值残差不充当史料精度。

data_files.scope: Available when ephemeris_policy=require_data_files. Read the actual observed physical models, file hashes, reference zeros and private-worker reports. Native event-internal reads, fixed-star catalogue formulae and absolute accuracy are not certified. This card does not set the input policy.

hour_origin.purpose: 核对已确认的午夜／正午起算小时标签：原历法日期、原小时与进位后的标准钟面分别读取，再看实际TT／UT1；不推断原图口径，不当作时区修正或实际持续时长。

physical_epoch.description: 输入钟时、原生TT/UT1及UTC显示标签；太阳时物理轴保留秒60。普通civil分支utc_representation可为null，未宣称原始资料或实测EOP已认证。

ut1_input.purpose: 核对明确选择的模型或IERS20 C04 UT1来源、固定覆盖期、源文件指纹、插值区间与未应用修正；盘面与地平计算仍要求覆盖内UT1；地心TT黄经事件不外推UT1即可跨边界搜索，未取得瞬时观测误差或现实预测证据。

as_of.description: Freeze implicit current time: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone

candidate_calendar.description: Explicit calendar for candidate date labels; CE Jan1 years, no automatic regional reform or old-style year/clock reconstruction. Normalize date labels before applying timezone.

candidate_clock_basis.description: Explicit candidate clock: civil, local mean solar (UT1 + east longitude/360), or geocentric local apparent solar (adds EOT). Solar labels require timezone_name omitted/null; unknown original clocks stay unknown.

candidate_hour_origin.description: Explicit hour-label origin: midnight(default) hour0=00:00; noon hour0=same-date12:00 and hour12..23=next-date00:00..11:00. Confirm the source convention first; independent of civil/LMT/LAT, never an elapsed duration, timezone offset or automatic historical inference. Normalize calendar/day carry before applying timezone.

candidate_year.description: Year of the candidate moment being evaluated

compact.description: 紧凑 JSON 输出（无缩进）；设为 false 则美化缩进。默认 true。

ephemeris_policy.description: auto retains and reports actual available models. require_data_files rejects analytical/orbital fallback for observed physical coordinates throughout the request, including clocks and samples; checks data contexts and endpoint hashes. Native rise/set query/result epochs are probed, but internal solver reads are not fully observable. Analytical points, fictitious elements, reference zeros and Earth rotation are separate; this is not an astronomical-accuracy or prediction certificate.

fields.description: 仅返回选定字段以节省 token：接受顶层键（如 'snapshot_text'）或点路径子字段（如 'bazi_birth.day_master'）。run_metadata 始终保留；留空请求全部字段，超出响应字符预算的部分由 result_delivery 保留供读取。无效路径默认附 projection_warnings；strict_fields=true 时拒绝。

house_system.description: House system, any convention (SE letter / key / integer code 0..8); Regiomontanus (R, code 2) is traditional for elections. Explicit values must be supported letters/names or integer codes0..8; unknown, blank, boolean and floating-point selections are rejected without substitution. Gauquelin (G) has36 clockwise sectors and is unavailable here.

include_snapshot_text.description: 是否包含人类可读的 snapshot_text 文本段（默认随工具而定）；设为 false 可显著减少返回的 token 数。

latitude.description: Latitude where the act will take place

longitude.description: Longitude where the act will take place

parent_run_id.description: Parent call's run_id; correlation only, no stored execution lookup

response_char_limit.description: 完整 JSON 响应字符预算：0 不限制，或 4096–65536。MCP 默认 8192，REST/CLI 默认 0。超限不截断数据，返回 result_delivery 完整结果引用和可读取字段；按 manifest_uri 或字段分页读取原 run 的数据，不要重新计算或解析单页为完整文档。

strict_fields.description: 是否拒绝无效 fields 路径；默认 false，使用宽松投影并返回警告。

timezone_name.description: Civil candidate timezone (IANA or UTC offset). Omitted/null with civil preserves legacy +08:00; use the known zone explicitly. Omit/null for solar clock bases, never combine both corrections.

topic_id.description: Undertaking type, selecting the rule pack: marriage/business/move_in/buy_property/trade/buy_car/contract/travel/job_hunt/general; 不提供医疗择时

ut1_source.description: Earth-rotation time source: legacy Swiss Delta T model(default), or pinned IERS20 C04 final daily UT1 series,1962-01-01T00:00UTC..2026-09-19T00:00UTC. No prediction/extrapolation/model fallback outside coverage; UT1-only correction, not full EOP. Geocentric TT longitude-event searches need no trial UT1; houses and horizon calculations still require covered UT1 epochs.

zodiac_type.description: Zodiac type, e.g. Tropic or Sidereal
